summary: Control-plane compaction evicts ephemeral pin entries; cohort diverted to compatibility quantized variant
description: Issue summary: During a staged canary rollout for redwood-open-7B-fp16 on customer BrightHealth AI's private deployment, a subset of streaming sessions unexpectedly lost their pinned model version and were routed to a legacy 'compat' quantized variant. Impact: several long-running streaming conversations truncated or changed tokenization mid-stream; customer reported degraded output quality and one billing spike due to unexpected reprocessing. Environment: Private deployment (customer-managed VPC) with control-plane snapshotting and compaction enabled. Preliminary timeline in ticket body.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Start a canary wave on private cluster in us-east-1 with prewarm enabled. 2) Begin long-running streaming sessions for a cohort (sessions typically keep a pin for 24h). 3) Trigger a control-plane snapshot compaction job (scheduled hourly by default) or wait for automatic compaction. 4) Observe session routing: some sessions lose explicit pin and are routed to compat quantized pool. Expected: pins persist across compaction; routing should stay to fp16 variant.
logs: Edge logs show 403->200 pin lookup fallback: orchestrator.log entries around 2026-03-05T14:12:33Z indicate 'pin_lookup: entry missing, falling back to heuristic selection'. Control-plane snapshot service logged 'compaction: removed 1.2k ephemeral entries' at 2026-03-05T14:12:30Z. Serving-runtime trace IDs: trace-6f9a3a and trace-6f9a8b show tokenization mismatch errors mid-stream. Customer-side session IDs supplied in attached anonymized log block.
investigation_notes:
- Initial hypothesis: snapshot compaction incorrectly pruned ephemeral pin records that should be retained until session-resume TTL.
- Reproduced locally on staging by enabling compaction with shortened TTLs; reproduced cohort diversion within 2-3 compaction cycles.
- Found control-plane code path: compaction used global 'last_active' timestamp instead of per-pin 'session_reserve_until', causing entries with recent resume tokens to be treated as stale.
- Correlated with orchestrator behavior: upon missing pin, orchestrator uses route heuristic which prefers lowest-cost compat pool under capacity pressure; that selected a quantized variant causing tokenization deltas.
- Related PR referenced in debug: github.com/redwood/control-plane/commit/4b3e9a2 (instrumentation only).
- No network/TLS issues found. No GPU preemption events in the serving cluster during the window.
resolution_notes: Workarounds applied: 1) Temporarily disabled compaction on BrightHealth AI's private control-plane snapshot service (t=2026-03-05T18:04Z). 2) Increased ephemeral pin TTL to 48h for affected tenant. 3) Pinned live sessions to explicit variant via control-plane pin-override API while full fix rolled out. Permanent fix: landed change to compaction logic to consult per-pin 'session_reserve_until' and skip entries actively reserved for resume (PR: github.com/redwood/control-plane/pull/3024). Deployed to private customers via control-plane agent 1.14.2 on 2026-03-07. Added alerting to detect 'compaction removed >0 reserved pins' and a dashboard panel for pin drop-rate.
